Arcane Subtlety.text: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 5 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 20%.

Arcane Focus.text: Reduces the chance that the opponent can resist your Arcane spells by 2%.

Improved Arcane Missiles.text: Gives you a 20% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles.

Wand Specialization.text: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

Magic Absorption.text: Increases all resistances by 2 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. 1 sec. cooldown.

Arcane Concentration.text: Gives you a 2% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

Magic Attunement.text: Increases the effect of your Amplify Magic and Dampen Magic spells by 25%.

Improved Arcane Explosion.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane Explosion spell by an additional 2%.

Arcane Resilience.text: Increases your armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect.

Improved Mana Shield.text: Decreases the mana lost per point of damage taken when Mana Shield is active by 10%.

Improved Counterspell.text: Gives your Counterspell a 50% chance to silence the target for 4 sec.

Arcane Meditation.text: Allows 5% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Presence of Mind.text: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

Arcane Instability.text: Increases your spell damage and critical strike chance by 1%.

Arcane Power.text: When activated, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast. This effect lasts 15 sec.

Improved Fireball.text: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball spell by 0.1 sec.

Impact.text: Gives your Fire spells a 2% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

Ignite.text: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 8% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

Flame Throwing.text: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 3 yards.

Improved Fire Blast.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 0.5 sec.

Incinerate.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast and Scorch spells by 2%.

Improved Flamestrike.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 5%.

Pyroblast.text: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 148 to 195 Fire damage and an additional 56 Fire damage over 12 sec.

Burning Soul.text: Gives your Fire spells a 35% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 15%.

Improved Scorch.text: Your Scorch spells have a 33% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases the Fire damage dealt to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.

Improved Fire Ward.text: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 10% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

Master of Elements.text: Your Fire and Frost spell criticals will refund 10% of their base mana cost.

Critical Mass.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.

Blast Wave.text: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 159 to 192 Fire damage, and dazing them for 6 sec.

Fire Power.text: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2%.

Combustion.text: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 critical strikes with Fire spells.

Frost Warding.text: Increases the armor and resistances given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a 10% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.

Improved Frostbolt.text: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.1 sec.

Elemental Precision.text: Reduces the chance that the opponent can resist your Frost and Fire spells by 2%.

Ice Shards.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 20%.

Frostbite.text: Gives your Chill effects a 5% chance to freeze the target for 5 sec.

Improved Frost Nova.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 2 sec.

Permafrost.text: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 1 sec and reduces the target's speed by an additional 4%.

Piercing Ice.text: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 2%.

Cold Snap.text: When activated, this spell finishes the cooldown on all of your Frost spells.

Improved Blizzard.text: Adds a chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 30%. Lasts 1.50 sec.

Arctic Reach.text: Increases the range of your Frostbolt and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.

Frost Channeling.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 5% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 10%.

Shatter.text: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against frozen targets by 10%.

Ice Block.text: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move or cast spells.

Improved Cone of Cold.text: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 15%.

Winter's Chill.text: Gives your Frost damage spells a 20% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance a Frost spell will critically hit the target by 2% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.

Ice Barrier.text: Instantly shields you, absorbing 455 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, spells will not be interrupted.
